test_title: PYST 25: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

This book __giving us much information__ about our freedom fighters who lost their lives while serving our motherland.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The underlined segment "giving us much information" should be in the present simple tense to agree with the subject "This book."
 
• The correct form of the verb is "gives" to match the singular subject "book."
 
• Additionally, we use "much information" (not "many information") because "information" is an uncountable noun.

Therefore, the corrected sentence should be "This book gives us much information about our freedom fighters who lost their lives while serving our motherland."

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"This book gives us much information about our freedom fighters who lost their lives while serving our motherland."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **Option 1: "gives us many information"** – "many information" is incorrect; "information" is uncountable, so "much information" should be used.
 
• **Option 2: "give us many information"** – The verb "give" does not agree with the singular subject "This book," and "many information" is also incorrect.
 
• **Option 3: "give us much information"** – The verb "give" does not agree with the singular subject "This book."
